paragraphs: STEM Racing is a multi-disciplinary global challenge where student teams design, engineer, and manufacture miniature compressed air-powered cars based on official regulations.
It goes beyond racing—demanding excellence in project management, enterprise, aerodynamic design, and rigorous testing to achieve maximum velocity and efficiency.

pillars.title: WHY CARDINAL?
paragraphs: We are a pre-professional engineering syndicate. We operate at the intersection of precision engineering, high-velocity aerodynamics, premium aesthetics, and aggressive brand strategy.
Cardinal refers to fundamental reference directions— fixed points that bring clarity and precision.
For us, it represents designing with intent, not guesswork. Every decision aligns to a clear reference: performance, compliance, and purpose.

pillars.title: FURTHER BEYOND.
paragraphs: Further Beyond defines our mindset. It means going past the first acceptable solution. Past assumptions. Past limits set by convention.
We believe performance emerges from refinement— through iteration, analysis, and intent.
Further Beyond is not about excess, but about pushing carefully, intelligently, and consistently.
